# Policy

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:policy from schema.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

`agentcurfew.policy.json` at the root of a project sets what its agent components may be. `agentcurfew init` writes one that the project passes as it is; `agentcurfew doctor` checks it against [schema.json](../schema.json), and `scan`, `lock` and `verify` refuse to run with a policy that does not follow it.

Settings that are true or false move the level of a rule (a finding then names the setting); lists of allowed sources and servers feed the rule `out-of-policy`; `exclude` leaves paths out of everything; `exceptions` accept findings, each with a reason, and with `until` only to that date.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | string | The address of this schema, for editors. |
| `version` | `1`, required | Version of the policy format. |
| `failOn` | `"critical"`, `"high"`, `"medium"`, `"low"`, `"none"` | Default --fail-on of agentcurfew scan: the lowest level that makes it exit with 1. The flag wins over it. |
| `skills` | object | Rules for skills. |
| `skills.allowSources` | list of strings | Where skills may come from: the source field of skills-lock.json, matched as a glob (* within a segment, ** across segments). local allows skills that skills-lock.json does not list. When set, any other skill is out of policy. |
| `skills.allowExecutables` | boolean | false makes a skill that bundles programs or scripts out of policy. |
| `mcp` | object | Rules for MCP servers. |
| `mcp.requirePinnedVersions` | boolean | true raises unpinned-mcp-server to high; false lowers it to info. |
| `mcp.allowServers` | list of strings | Which servers may be configured: the package or image a launcher fetches, or the server's address, matched as a glob. local allows servers started from a local command. When set, any other server is out of policy. |
| `mcp.denyPlainHttp` | boolean | true keeps plain-http-mcp at high; false lowers it to info. |
| `hooks` | object | Rules for hooks and automatic tasks. |
| `hooks.allowNetwork` | boolean | false raises hooks that open a network connection to high; true lowers them to info. Downloads that are run stay high either way. |
| `hooks.allowAutoRunOnOpen` | boolean | false raises auto-run-on-open to high; true lowers it to info. |
| `contextFiles` | object | Rules for context files and other text the agent reads. |
| `contextFiles.denyHiddenUnicode` | boolean | true keeps hidden-unicode as it is; false lowers it to info. |
| `exclude` | list of objects | Paths that are not scanned, locked or verified at all. |
| `exclude[].path` | string, required | A glob relative to the project, with / separators. |
| `exclude[].reason` | string, required | Why the path is left out. |
| `exceptions` | list of objects | Findings that are accepted, each with a reason, until a date when one is given. |
| `exceptions[].rule` | string, required | The id of the rule. |
| `exceptions[].path` | string, required | A glob of the files the exception covers. |
| `exceptions[].reason` | string, required | Why the finding is accepted. |
| `exceptions[].until` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | YYYY-MM-DD: from the day after, the finding is reported again. |
| `doctor` | object | Settings of agentcurfew doctor. |
| `doctor.failOn` | `"error"`, `"warning"`, `"info"`, `"none"` | The lowest level that makes agentcurfew doctor exit with 1; warning by default. |

Globs: `*` stays within a path segment, `**` crosses segments, `?` is one character, and a glob that names a folder covers everything below it.
